captions.caption: A wide shot shows a tranquil tropical beach with white sand and palm trees.
A man in a blue shirt sits against a palm tree holding a coconut.
The man uses a knife to carve into the top of the brown coconut.
He continues to strike the coconut with the knife to remove the husk.
The man carefully peels away layers of the coconut husk with his knife.
He uses the knife to pry open a small hole in the coconut.
The man repeatedly stabs the top of the coconut to reach the water inside.
He works the knife around the top edge of the coconut.
The man finishes opening the coconut and prepares to drink from it.
He raises the coconut to his lips while leaning against the tree.
The man drinks the coconut water with the beach visible in the background.
He continues to drink from the coconut, tilting his head back.
The man takes a long drink from the coconut on the sunny beach.
He keeps the coconut to his mouth, enjoying the refreshing drink.
The man continues drinking the coconut water steadily.
He remains focused on finishing the drink from the coconut.
The man finishes the drink and starts to lower the coconut from his face.
He lowers the coconut and looks towards the camera.
The man begins to speak to the camera about his experience.
The scene cuts to a close-up of the man's face in dark, warm lighting.
The man's face is lit from below as he speaks into the camera.
An inset image of the moon over the ocean appears in the top right corner.
The man talks about the lemonade he drank at Flamenco Beach.
He continues his narration, mentioning the amount of water he consumed.
He describes his walk back to Tamarindo Grande Beach.
The man mentions rinsing off in outdoor showers before his walk.
He continues speaking in the dimly lit environment.
The man explains his plan to find a place to camp for the night.
His face remains centered as he narrates his journey.
He finishes his thought while the inset image remains visible.
The man concludes his indoor narration.
The man is still speaking to the camera in the dark setting.
The video cuts to the man walking on a trail through green bushes.
He walks quickly along the narrow path, looking around at the forest.
The man speaks to the camera while hiking through the dense vegetation.
He describes the beauty of the island and the sound of birds.
The man continues his trek, breathing steadily as he moves.
He is seen walking through the trees from a side view.
The man walks past tall grass and thick green leaves.
He looks toward the trees as he navigates the trail.
The man continues to walk and talk about his route.
He moves through the lush green environment under a cloudy sky.
The man is shown walking on the path, which is lined with shrubs.
He looks around at the scenic view while walking.
The man continues his hike through the island's interior.
He is walking towards a beach on the other side of the island.
A map of Isla Culebra appears, showing a red line for the path.
The red dotted line on the map moves across the island's geography.
The map shows the route from one beach to another.
The red line reaches the destination on the map's coastline.
The map provides a detailed view of the island's terrain.
The video returns to the man walking through the green woods.
He explains that he will spend the night near the beach.
The man continues walking along the trail surrounded by trees.
He mentions carrying three liters of water for his journey.
The man is shown walking through a particularly dense part of the path.
He keeps moving forward, with the camera capturing his profile.
The man continues his walk through the island's vegetation.
He is seen walking past large green leaves and branches.
The man talks to the camera while navigating the trail.
